inventory.module.name: Inventory
inventory.module.description: The theatre's props, costume, set and technical kit: what it owns, where each thing is, who has borrowed it, whether it is safe to use, and when it leaves for good. Nothing is ever lent twice over the same time.
Loan length offered when no end date is given
For a member or an outside borrower. They can choose a different end date, up to the longest loan.
inventory.settings.loans.max-length.help: No loan may run longer than this.
inventory.settings.loans.production-grac: Production kit is due back after the last performance by
Counted from the production's last performance. Moving the production's dates moves its loans with it.
inventory.settings.loans.remind-before.l: Remind the borrower before kit is due back
inventory.settings.loans.overdue-every.h: The borrower and the department are both told, until the kit comes back.
inventory.settings.loans.keep-for.label: Keep a borrower's details after a loan ends for
inventory.settings.loans.keep-for.help: Then their name, contact details and anything written about them are erased. The loan stays in each item's history.
inventory.settings.inspections.remind-be: The weekly inspections reminder looks ahead
Each department's inspectors are sent what falls due within this, and what is overdue.
inventory.settings.inspections.first-due: A new item's first inspection is due
Taking new kit as tested suits a theatre that buys new and tested.
On the day it is added
One interval after it is added
inventory.settings.faults.keep-for.label: Keep a closed fault's description and photos for
inventory.settings.faults.keep-for.help: Then they are erased. The item's history still shows that the fault happened and how it was closed.
inventory.settings.disposals.approve-abo: A disposal needs a second person's approval above
The item's replacement value. Nothing means every disposal needs a second person.
inventory.settings.catalogue.members-bro: Each kit department still chooses whether it lends to members.
inventory.settings.labels.size.label: Label size
inventory.settings.labels.size.help: The sheet of labels you print on.
inventory.settings.hired-in.remind-befor: Remind the department before hired-in kit goes back
For kit the theatre has hired or borrowed from someone else.
